the RSV genome has been sequenced, and its complete genome structure and functions have been determined; several RSV genes have also been identified, and their functions in virus replication have been determined; and RSV resistance genes have been identified in rice.

the development of new technologies for the detection and diagnosis of RSV, the development of RSV-resistant rice varieties, and the elucidation of the molecular mechanism of RSV resistance will be important for future RSV research.
